buildGaps.detail: The 1370cdab original sharedUid APK and its complete corresponding source/build modifications are not reconstructed or independently matched here; no original APK is bundled.

The historical arm64 Hangul change was a SHA-pinned ELF/table repair. A source-equivalent header delta is included, but the complete original native/submodule build and ABI equivalence have not been verified.
A new clean source build and offline archive rebuild passed independently. They do not reconstruct or establish equivalence with the historical installed APK.
The DEX patch tools require exact pinned original/stage DEX and independently compiled policy/helper DEX; binary baselines and old receipts are intentionally not shipped.

No signing key is distributed. The new source candidate uses an explicit fork version and a reviewed public development certificate; historical exact signed APK bytes and generic installation compatibility are not reconstructed.

historicalReconstructionFields: correspondingSourceComplete, apkRebuildVerified and buildGaps describe historical APK byte reconstruction; freshSourceBuild is independent.
